description: Contains Dialogflow CX intent definitions, including their training phrases and associated entities.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: agent_project_id
schema.description: The Google Cloud project ID of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_location_id
schema.description: The GCP region or location of the Dialogflow CX agent (e.g., 'us-central1').

schema.name: agent_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: intent_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX intent.

schema.name: intent_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX intent.

schema.name: description
schema.description: The user-provided description of the intent's purpose.

schema.name: labels
schema.description: A list of key-value pairs used to categorize and filter intents.

schema.name: training_phrases
schema.description: A list of user utterances that trigger this intent.

fields.name: phrase_text
fields.description: The raw text of the training phrase.

fields.name: phrase_annotated
fields.description: The training phrase with annotations for any identified entities.

fields.name: entity_types
fields.description: A list of entity types that are annotated within this training phrase.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the annotated entity type.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: The display name of the annotated entity type.
